title: Warsh, After Talking Tough on Inflation, Faces a ‘No-Win Situation’ on Rates
summary: Kevin M. Warsh, the chairman of the Federal Reserve, must soon decide whether to raise interest rates if inflation does not ease, even if it draws President Trump’s ire.
